notes.text: The odor of cultured butter is created by only three KFOs.
Yeast fermentation products shared by all alcoholic beverages, plus (E)-beta-damascenone.
Odorants characterising spirits in addition to the general fermentation metabolites.
High odor impact in beer, mostly formed during malting; 4-vinylguaiacol in wheat beer, linalool in Pilsner-type beer.
Additional fermentation products with high odor impact in red and white wine.
Individualist odorant of red and white wine (also orange juice).
Released from oak wood upon toasting.
Esters, terpenoids and aldehydes shared by orange and grapefruit juice.
Shared with orange juice, plus thiols that solely coin the grapefruit signature; acetaldehyde and (R)-limonene reach high levels.
Green aldehyde, fruity esters and a high OAV of furaneol.
As strawberry, plus two odorants that differentiate pineapple.
